name: nuclear receptor corepressor 1

function.text: NCOR1 encodes nuclear receptor corepressor 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of miRNA transcription.
